                       Courgette Black Beauty - 2x Plug Plants - Compact, Prolific Cropper
                      
                     





                     
                      
                      The Courgette Black Beauty plant plugs are compact and prolific croppers, perfect for garden and patio planting. These seedling plants, commonly known as Zucchini (Courgette), come in a pack of 2 and feature a striking black colour. Ideal for those looking to add a productive and visually appealing vegetable to their garden, these plant plugs are sure to thrive and provide a bountiful harvest.
